faqs.question: What is the purpose of this internship resource portal?
faqs.answer: The portal provides a centralized platform for accessing internship domains, project information, FAQs, guidelines and learning resources.

faqs.question: Which technologies are used to build this portal?
faqs.answer: The frontend uses HTML, CSS, JavaScript and JSON. AWS services will be used for cloud hosting, object storage and serverless integration.

faqs.question: Can interns access learning resources?
faqs.answer: Yes. The resources section provides links to technical documentation, tutorials and official learning websites.

faqs.question: Is the portal accessible on mobile devices?
faqs.answer: Yes. The website uses responsive CSS to support desktop, tablet and mobile screens.

faqs.question: How can I find a particular project or resource?
faqs.answer: Use the portal search bar and category filter to find internship domains, projects and learning materials.

faqs.question: Does this portal replace the official internship dashboard?
faqs.answer: No. This is an independent learning prototype and does not replace any existing Veda Technology system.
